question.text: A company files a rights issue of Rs. 8 crore. What is the SEBI filing fee applicable?

explanation.text: The Logic: For rights issues of Rs. 10 crore or less, SEBI charges a flat filing fee of Rs. 50,000. Since this rights issue is Rs. 8 crore, the flat Rs. 50,000 fee applies. For rights issues above Rs. 10 crore, the fee is 0.05% of the issue size. The Trap: Rs. 1 lakh is the flat filing fee for public issues up to Rs. 10 crore, not rights issues. Rs. 10,000 is not a prescribed slab. Applying 0.05% to Rs. 8 crore (Rs. 40,000) is wrong because the ad-valorem rate kicks in only above Rs. 10 crore. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation cleaned to neutral Series IX fee-table wording.
